name: Pāmu / Landcorp Farming
story: Pāmu used enterprise and field GIS for farm operations and asset decisions. Eagle’s published case records ArcGIS Online and Survey123 supporting winter-grazing decisions, while conference material records wider natural and built asset-management use.

sources.label: Eagle Technology, Pāmu and Esri help solve winter grazing challenges
New Zealand Esri User Conference programme, 2019
